title: 29 countries sign agreement on establishing World AI Cooperation Organization
authority_note: Primary official report of the signing ceremony (Xinhua via gov.cn).
claims: 29 countries signed the WAICO establishment agreement in Shanghai on July 16, 2026
WAICO is an independent intergovernmental international organization headquartered in Shanghai
Foreign Minister Wang Yi signed for China; named signatory examples: Kazakhstan, Laos, Pakistan, Russia, Indonesia
UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres present at the signing ceremony
draft_usage: Cited for the 29-country signing fact under Social (WAICO).
issues: Article names only five signatory examples; does not enumerate all 29.
